name: inspect_eve_assembly_state
title: EVE Frontier Smart Assembly On-Chain State & Capability Inspector
description: Inspects live EVE Frontier Smart Assembly on-chain object metadata, owner capability ID, online power status, and attached Sui Move package digest. Use when verifying whether a Smart Turret, Smart Gate, or Smart Storage Unit is online and checking its bound Move module before interacting; for generating or auditing custom Sui Move assembly source code, use generate_eve_assembly_move instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'assembly_id' ('assembly_class' defaults to 'smart_gate'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (80 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

assembly_id.description: Hexadecimal Sui object ID or Frontier Smart Assembly identifier (e.g. '0x8f4a...c201' or 'assembly-alpha-01').

assembly_class.description: Smart Assembly hardware class used to validate expected capability fields; defaults to 'smart_gate' when omitted.

assembly_id.description: Canonical Smart Assembly object identifier inspected.

owner_cap_id.description: Bound Sui Move OwnerCap object ID controlling administrative permissions.

attached_package_digest.description: SHA-256 bytecode digest of the custom Move extension attached to this assembly.

annotations.title: EVE Frontier Smart Assembly On-Chain State & Capability Inspector

name: audit_eve_tribe_standings
title: EVE Frontier Tribe Diplomatic Standings & Access Matrix Auditor
description: Audits EVE Frontier Tribe diplomatic standings, friendly/hostile reputation scores, and pilot override entries across solar systems. Use when checking diplomatic relations or detecting conflicting friendly-fire rules across tribe registries; for compiling those standings into executable Sui Move Smart Gate ACL bytecode, use compile_eve_gate_acl instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'tribe_id' ('standing_filter' defaults to 'all'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (80 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

tribe_id.description: Primary Tribe identifier or registry object ID to audit (e.g. 'tribe-corinth-01').

standing_filter.description: Filter returned diplomatic relationships by tier; defaults to 'all' when omitted.

allied_tribes_count.description: Count of tribes holding positive diplomatic standing.

hostile_tribes_count.description: Count of tribes flagged as hostile targets.

acl_conflicts_detected.description: True if a pilot override contradicts their parent tribe standing.

annotations.title: EVE Frontier Tribe Diplomatic Standings & Access Matrix Auditor

name: generate_eve_assembly_move
title: EVE Frontier Sui Move Smart Assembly Contract Generator & Auditor
description: Generates and statically audits Sui Move smart contract modules for EVE Frontier Smart Assemblies using Witness, Capability, and HotPotato patterns. Use when authoring custom Sui Move extensions for Smart Gates, Smart Turrets, or Smart Storage Units; for simulating pre-signed Programmable Transaction Block command arrays before wallet execution, use simulate_eve_sui_ptb instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'contract_type' ('assembly_id' defaults to 'standard'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (200 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

contract_type.description: Target EVE Frontier Smart Assembly archetype to synthesize and audit.

assembly_id.description: Optional Smart Assembly identifier to bind into module constants; defaults to 'frontier-assembly-01' when omitted.

module_name.description: Fully qualified Sui Move module identifier (e.g. 'frontier::smart_gate').

sui_move_code.description: Complete, syntactically valid Sui Move smart contract source code.

move_patterns_used.description: Verified Sui Move safety patterns enforced in the module.

security_audit_passed.description: True when Witness drop and Capability access checks pass static verification.

annotations.title: EVE Frontier Sui Move Smart Assembly Contract Generator & Auditor

name: compile_eve_gate_acl
title: EVE Frontier Smart Gate Tribe ACL & Dynamic Toll Bytecode Compiler
description: Compiles EVE Frontier Tribe access control lists, diplomatic standings, and surge-pricing toll rules into Sui Move Smart Gate AccessPolicy constraints. Use when configuring on-chain jump permissions and LUX/SUI toll schedules for a player-owned Smart Gate; for calculating optimal multi-system jump routes across existing stargates, use plan_eve_gate_route instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'gate_assembly_id' ('toll_mode' defaults to 'standing_tiered'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (130 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

toll_mode.description: Pricing curve applied to non-allied jumpers; defaults to 'standing_tiered' when omitted.

access_policy_move_struct.description: Compiled Sui Move AccessPolicy struct definition and entry verifier.

base_toll_mist.description: Calculated base jump toll denominated in MIST/LUX units.

hostile_block_enforced.description: True when hostile tribes are rejected at the Move witness gate.

annotations.title: EVE Frontier Smart Gate Tribe ACL & Dynamic Toll Bytecode Compiler

name: simulate_eve_sui_ptb
title: EVE Frontier Sui Move PTB Coin-Drain & HotPotato Safety Simulator
description: Simulates Sui Programmable Transaction Block (PTB) command sequences to detect unauthorized coin splits, object transfers, and unconsumed HotPotato receipts. Use when auditing an untrusted EVE Frontier transaction bundle before signing with a pilot wallet; for verifying pilot zkLogin JWT proofs and character ownership capabilities, use verify_eve_zklogin_character instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'ptb_commands_json' ('strictness_mode' defaults to 'strict_zero_drain'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (150 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

ptb_commands_json.description: JSON-serialized array of PTB commands or comma-separated Move calls (e.g. '[{"kind":"SplitCoins"},{"kind":"MoveCall"}]').

strictness_mode.description: Simulation policy controlling whether multi-transfer PTBs are blocked; defaults to 'strict_zero_drain' when omitted.

ptb_command_count.description: Number of PTB commands statically simulated.

hot_potato_receipts_balanced.description: True if every Move HotPotato struct created in the PTB is consumed before exit.

hidden_coin_transfer_detected.description: True if unauthorized SplitCoins or TransferObjects drains are detected.

annotations.title: EVE Frontier Sui Move PTB Coin-Drain & HotPotato Safety Simulator

name: verify_eve_zklogin_character
title: EVE Frontier Sui zkLogin BN254 Proof & SmartCharacter Verifier
description: Verifies EVE Frontier Sui zkLogin BN254 zero-knowledge proofs, ephemeral session signatures, and SmartCharacter ownership capabilities. Use when authenticating a pilot's off-chain OAuth/zkLogin session before granting tribe vault or dApp access; for auditing tribe-wide diplomatic standings and reputation registries, use audit_eve_tribe_standings instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'jwt_proof' ('ephemeral_scheme' defaults to 'ED25519'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (100 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

jwt_proof.description: Encoded Sui zkLogin proof payload or JWT session token string (minimum 20 characters).

ephemeral_scheme.description: Cryptographic signature scheme of the ephemeral session key; defaults to 'ED25519' when omitted.

character_verified.description: True when the zkLogin BN254 proof and salt derivation are valid.

sui_address_derived.description: Deterministic 32-byte Sui address derived from the zkLogin issuer and salt.

tribe_acl_eligible.description: True if the verified SmartCharacter holds active Tribe membership.

annotations.title: EVE Frontier Sui zkLogin BN254 Proof & SmartCharacter Verifier

name: plan_eve_gate_route
title: EVE Frontier Multi-Hop Smart Gate Fuel & Toll Route Planner
description: Calculates optimal stargate jump routes between EVE Frontier solar systems minimizing gigajoule fuel consumption, LUX gate tolls, or jump count. Use when plotting a ship transit path across public and tribe-restricted Smart Gates; for identifying multi-system commodity arbitrage trade loops across Smart Storage Units, use find_eve_ssu_arbitrage instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'origin_system' ('destination_system' defaults to 'standard'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (100 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

optimize_for.description: Routing objective function weighting fuel burn vs tolls; defaults to 'lowest_fuel' when omitted.

optimal_hops.description: Total number of stargate jumps along the selected path.

waypoints.description: Ordered list of solar systems and Lagrange Smart Gates traversed.

estimated_fuel_burn_gj.description: Total ship fuel consumption in gigajoules (GJ) across the route.

total_gate_tolls_lux.description: Cumulative Smart Gate transit tolls required in LUX.

annotations.title: EVE Frontier Multi-Hop Smart Gate Fuel & Toll Route Planner

name: optimize_eve_node_power
title: EVE Frontier Lagrange Network Node Gigajoule & Fuel Burn Optimizer

operating_profile.description: Power allocation profile across connected assemblies; defaults to 'balanced' when omitted.

burn_rate_gj_per_hr.description: Hourly gigajoule (GJ) energy consumption across attached assemblies.

hours_until_fuel_depletion.description: Remaining operational hours before fuel reserves reach zero.

annotations.title: EVE Frontier Lagrange Network Node Gigajoule & Fuel Burn Optimizer

name: simulate_eve_capacitor_siege
title: EVE Frontier Lagrange Node Siege Capacitor Depletion Simulator
description: Simulates Lagrange Network Node gigajoule (GJ) capacitor drain under sustained hostile fleet siege and computes optimal assembly load-shedding order. node_id.description: Target Lagrange Network Node identifier under siege simulation.

siege_intensity.description: Hostile fleet DPS and electronic-warfare drain tier; defaults to 'heavy_cruiser_wing' when omitted.

capacitor_survival_minutes.description: Minutes before capacitor reserves drop below turret firing threshold.

load_shedding_sequence.description: Ordered list of non-essential assemblies to power down first.

name: monitor_eve_constellation_fuel
title: EVE Frontier Constellation Sovereignty & Multi-Node Fuel Radar
description: Monitors constellation-wide Lagrange Network Node fuel reserves, identifies the weakest sovereignty node, and calculates logistics convoy resupply urgency. Use when auditing multi-system sovereignty fuel health across an entire tribe constellation; for optimizing gigajoule load on a single individual Lagrange Network Node, use optimize_eve_node_power instead. constellation_id.description: Constellation or solar system cluster identifier (e.g. 'Frontier-Delta-09').

sovereignty_health_index.description: Normalized sovereignty stability score from 0.0 to 1.0.

weakest_node_id.description: Identifier of the Network Node closest to fuel exhaustion.

name: quote_eve_ssu_market
